ကြွေပန်းကန် ယူခဲ့ပါ။
မြွေထိက ဆေးခန်းသွားရမည်။
ဆရာဝန် ကြွလာပြီ။
ကြွေပန်းအိုး ဝယ်လာသည်။
အကြွေး မဝယ်ပါ။
Let me serve and care for you.
Is that the sound of a snake or the wind?
If bitten by a snake, go to the clinic.
The child shakes the fruit down.
Do not let buffaloes and cows eat them.
ဘာပန်းကန်ကို ယူခဲ့ရမလဲ။  --- ကြွေပန်းကန်
ကြွေပန်းကန်ထဲမှာ ဘာအသီး ထည့်ထားရမလဲ။  --- ကျွဲကောသီး
မြွေသံလား၊ လေသံလား မသိရင် ဘာကို သတိထားရမလဲ။  --- မြွေ
ဆေးခန်းကို ဘယ်သူ ကြွလာပြီလဲ။  --- ဆရာဝန်
ဘယ်သူက အသီးတွေကို ချွေချတာလဲ။  --- လူကလေး
ပန်းအိုးဝယ်တဲ့အခါ ဘယ်လို မဝယ်ရဘူးလဲ။  --- အကြွေး
Who has arrived, children? --- Village elders.
Which plate should be brought? --- Porcelain plate.
Which fruit should be put in the porcelain plate? --- Pomelo.
If you don't know whether it's the sound of a snake or the wind, what should you watch out for? --- The snake.
Where should you go if bitten by a snake? --- The clinic.
Who has arrived at the clinic? --- The doctor.
Who is shaking down the fruits? --- The little boy.
What must not be allowed to eat the fallen fruits? --- Cattle.
How is the sweat dripping? --- Profusely.
What kind of flower vase was bought? --- Porcelain flower vase.
How should you not buy the vase? --- On credit.
How should you not behave? --- Boastfully.
